dialogues.speaker: Mine Message Board
dialogues.text: "Safety first! Safety first! Bravery and perseverance are important, but they're no match for falling rocks! Always wear your helmet while working, and never underestimate the importance of Article 1 of the Safety Regulations!"

dialogues.speaker: Mine Message Board
dialogues.text: "Also, playing loud music is not permitted in dangerous work areas! When you hear anything that sounds like trouble, report it immediately to help ensure the safety of the entire site!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Miner's Message
dialogues.text: "Thank you, 'Utha{RUBY#[D]Resilience}biti' Kachina!"

dialogues.speaker: Miner's Message
dialogues.text: "The unstable rocks you discovered before have already been taken care of, and no property damage or injuries occurred."

dialogues.speaker: Miner's Message
dialogues.text: "Though you left without saying a word, we all know you're a really enthusiastic and strong young lady!"

dialogues.speaker: Miner's Message
dialogues.text: "We'll all be rooting for you this Pilgrimage! Buck up, and don't think about the past! We're with you all the way!"

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "Article 3: When using power drills or other powered mining equipment, gloves are mandatory, and be sure to wear work pants, knee guards, and boots to fully protect your legs!"

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "No matter how uncomfortable the knee guards are, you may not remove them in the mines! If you injure your joints, chances are you won't be able to leave the mines at all!"

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "If any of your protective gear is damaged, please report it immediately."

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "Article 9: Make sure you have consumed the proper amount of food, oil, salt, and fluids in accordance with regulations before entering the mines."

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "Make sure you've got enough calories to burn, so you can maintain normal functionality in all areas. This is not only for taking care of your own body, but also for the sake of your entire crew!"

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "Should the miners in key positions not be able to complete their production operations in accordance with safety procedures due to physical issues, it could lead to a major accident, resulting in potentially life-threatening hazards for the entire crew!"

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "So, be sure to eat well before going down into the mine! Have two, three, as many servings as you need — it's not like the tribe's cafeteria's gonna run out of food! The Children of Echoes has never and will never be stingy with you!"

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "Article 133: Mining tools are not to be disassembled or repaired without authorization. In case of a malfunction or problem, the equipment in question is to be delivered to the Macuahuitl Workshop!"

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "And definitely don't go thinking the mining tools safe operation limits are set too low, or that they aren't up to the task, and make your own personal 'super modifications' to them..."

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "Last time, one of the crew adjusted the drill's power to three times the normal output... He's still in the hospital recovering, and we don't have any indication when his bones will mend or his hearing will recover."

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "If you're still not convinced, why not go have a chat with him yourself?"

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "Article 145: While on breaks during the night shift, if any workers still have the extra energy, time, and mood for such things, a reminder that no dance battling is allowed in the mines!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Why not? Afraid that if too many people dance, the mining pit'll collapse?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Now you're a smart Saurian cookie! But that's just part of it. The primary reason is that night dance battles are nor only allowed to take place on the Stage Tepetl."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Besides, isn't it just a colossal waste to dance where the lighting's bad, nobody's watching, and you can't even see your own moves properly?"

dialogues.speaker: Miner's Message
dialogues.text: "I've heard that the wilds aren't very safe recently, and that monster attacks on merchant caravans are getting more and more frequent. How will that affect sales of our tribe's ores? Will it impact the incomes of our crew?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "As for the problem with the volume of ore sales, Boss Pacal has mentioned it. The number of tourists visiting the People of the Springs has increased significantly, so they'll be importing way more raw materials than last year..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "The Scions of the Canopy are equipping their Couriers with new gear, and they need raw metals the most. The Masters of the Night-Wind and Flower-Feather Clan are both conducting extensive building renovations, so they'll also be using a considerable amount of ores."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "As for the Collective of Plenty, trade's always been stable, and the produce from Varesa's place has gotten even cheaper, so there's no need to worry about income!"

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I'd like to add that I've heard that all the tribes are in the middle of reorganizing their anti-monster patrols in accordance with the experience of the veterans, so the current increased threat is only temporary."

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "And so what if there's a few more monsters? We Children of Echoes happen to have more energy and zeal than we know what to do with! Put down your pickaxes and pick up your axes, we'll cut 'em all down!"

dialogues.speaker: Kitchen Notice
dialogues.text: "New dining option in the miner's cafeteria available this week!"

dialogues.speaker: Kitchen Notice
dialogues.text: "Combining the Jueyun Chilis from Liyue cuisine with Blazed Meat Stew, it has a fiery texture and colors bright as paint that'll give the fire in your bellies all the fuel it needs!"

dialogues.speaker: Kitchen Notice
dialogues.text: "Still, all mining crew members are encouraged to only try this new dish after work, as you may need to consume inordinate amounts of water, which may be detrimental to mining work."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Spicy? Yesss, that's what I'm talking about! The Fonta-flavored Grainfruit Meat Soup Cempoa invented last time was pretty good, nice and sweet, but it wasn't very filling..."

dialogues.speaker: Kitchen Notice
dialogues.text: "Thanks for you support! As for the Fonta-flavored Grainfruit Meat Soup, in light of the various different kinds of feedback received, the chefs will continue to modify and improve the dish and offer it from time to time as a specialty!"

dialogues.speaker: Lil' Saurian Announcements
dialogues.text: "Lil' Saurian of the Month: Nini. Reason: 'He loves showing everyone (including foreigners) his adorable tummy!'"

dialogues.speaker: Lil' Saurian Announcements
dialogues.text: "This Month's Naughtiest Lil' Saurian: Momo. Reason: 'Sharpening its teeth on Xilonen's potted plants, fighting with other Saurians in the middle of the night, stealing snacks, and hiding in Chanil's house to avoid punishment.'"
